description.en: Component collection and landing page blocks designed for Astro and Tailwind.
description.zh: 专为 Astro 框架与 Tailwind CSS 深度定制的轻量极速组件集合。

content.en: Bearnie is a lightweight UI kit and block collection purpose-built for the Astro web framework and styled with Tailwind CSS. It leverages Astro's zero-JS-by-default architecture to ship lightning-fast content sites, blogs, and SaaS landing pages with zero hydration overhead.
content.zh: Bearnie 是一套专为现代 Astro 静态站点生成框架量身打造的 Tailwind CSS 页面区块库。它完全契合 Astro「默认零 JavaScript」的群岛渲染理念，所提供的英雄区块、文章列表与导航栏均无不必要的客户端水合负担，实现近乎满分的性能跑分。
